summary: Apply durable presentation controls to served attention rows and schedule snooze expiry

replay.detail: Serving reads canonical attention.control registers; restarting reconstructs suppression and its next wake from durable claims.

compatibility.detail: Direct and published attention collections omit dismissed and currently snoozed rows without resolving their underlying work. Snooze deadlines join the existing server publication deadline; clear and restore claims republish the row. New source episodes invalidate previous controls.

manual.detail: Public control actions are unchanged in this serving-only change.

recovery.detail: The underlying attention source remains intact; inverse control claims restore its presentation.
